region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis visit screen program HCV1PL01: a pseudo-conversation that RETURNs TRANSID(EIBTRNID) with its WORKING-STORAGE COMM-AREA (no DFHCOMMAREA, so the COMMAREA is a layout_only record, #7434; the harness reads the RETURN commarea bytes, #8230). Every scenario starts with EIBCALEN 0, so the program SENDs the map and falls into RECEIVE MAP; it LINKs HCP1BI01 (patient name) and HCT1BI01 (thresholds) first, then HCV1 inquires through HCV1BI01 / HCIVDB01 and HCVA adds through HCV1BA01 / HCAVDB01. HCITDB01 DISPLAYs; the job log is compared too (the standalone Sysout honours gitgalaxy.sysout since #8246, port_blockers P128). Events, the RETURN COMMAREA bytes and the tables are compared. Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. The re-entry arm (EIBCALEN > 0, a COMMAREA the previous RETURN passed) is driven by commarea_hex scenarios: the program has no DFHCOMMAREA, so only EIBCALEN reads the bytes (#8121).

scenarios.name: inquire-visit
scenarios.why: HCV1 with patient 2 and the seeded date and time: HCV1BI01 LINKs HCIVDB01, heart rate and blood pressure are shown

scenarios.name: inquire-no-visit
scenarios.why: a date and time with no row: HCIVDB01 SQLCODE +100, CA-RETURN-CODE 01, the fields stay blank

scenarios.name: inquire-visit-select-fails
scenarios.why: the BLOODPRESSURE SELECT meets resource unavailable (-904): HCIVDB01 sets '90', so HCV1BI01 returns a code above 1 and HCV1PL01 skips the field moves (CA-RETURN-CODE <= 1 false)

scenarios.name: inquire-needs-datetime
scenarios.why: no date and time: the prompt, no visit LINK

scenarios.name: inquire-unknown-patient
scenarios.why: patient 99 does not exist: HCP1BI01 returns an error, NO-PATIENT-DATA

scenarios.name: add-visit
scenarios.why: HCVA with patient 1 and a new date and time: HCV1BA01 LINKs HCAVDB01, one BLOODPRESSURE and one HEARTRATE row inserted

scenarios.name: add-needs-datetime
scenarios.why: HCVA with no date and time: the prompt, no insert

scenarios.name: add-duplicate
scenarios.why: HCVA for patient 2 at the seeded date and time: the insert fails, rollback, NO-ADD error text

scenarios.name: other-transaction
scenarios.why: a transid that is neither HCV1 nor HCVA: no arm matches, the program takes the final RETURN

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF3: ENDIT sends "Transaction ended"

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF12: CANCELIT RETURNs TRANSID HCAZ IMMEDIATE

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID CLEAR: CLEARIT sends the map MAPONLY and RETURNs TRANSID(EIBTRNID)

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: no input: RECEIVE MAP raises MAPFAIL, HANDLE CONDITION sends ENDIT

scenarios.name: reentry-short-area
scenarios.why: re-entry with a one-byte area (the previous RETURN's COMMAREA): IF EIBCALEN > 0 GO TO A-GAIN (line 52), so the first-entry map send is skipped and the program goes to A-GAIN. The program has no DFHCOMMAREA, so only EIBCALEN reads the bytes (#8121)

scenarios.name: reentry-long-area
scenarios.why: re-entry with an eight-byte area (the previous RETURN's COMMAREA): IF EIBCALEN > 0 GO TO A-GAIN (line 52), so the first-entry map send is skipped and the program goes to A-GAIN. The program has no DFHCOMMAREA, so only EIBCALEN reads the bytes (#8121)
